steps.say: The standard \([[fn]]\) function has a base period of \([[base_period]]^\circ\), and the coefficient \(B = [[B]]\) inside the argument compresses the horizontal period by a factor of \([[B]]\).
Dividing the base period by \([[B]]\) gives \([[base_period]]^\circ / [[B]] = [[answer]]^\circ\).

answer: So the period of the graph is \([[answer]]^\circ\).
